name: The Pines Hotel
accommodation: Hotel bedrooms, many with balconies and sea views, plus holiday homes and a bungalow
beachAccess: Private steps directly down to the beach; walk along the seafront into Swanage
confirmedFeatures: Restaurant, lounge bar, gardens, EV charging, holiday homes, group facilities
overview: A hotel on the clifftops at the quieter end of Swanage Bay, with private steps down to the beach and a seafront walk into town. Many bedrooms have balconies and sea views, and it also lets holiday homes and a bungalow.
surfTripFit: Private beach steps mean quick access to the bay, and EV charging helps if you drive down.
